deviations.why: the ADR ledger was measured on the pre-#208 published tables, which carried only the collapsed winning-contrast row per gene; the v2 product publishes the authoritative pass-any-contrast deg flag, and a gene whose non-winning contrast passed the threshold is now a DEG (flag_source published_deg_flag).
